summary: Completed D1 Apply: created 4 formal output documents and verification.md from the 036-approved Proposal. docs/bootstrap-reference.md covers Bootstrap minimum loop, Run operation rules (with goal-change boundary), continuation cutpoint, Git 3-boundary model (Change activation not formal), ordinary Commit principles, Review not requiring Commit, owner authorization, Full Test not auto-triggered, media neutrality, and old-pattern correction table. docs/development-roadmap.md covers Deterministic Core, Change Execution Loop, Delivery Execution Loop, first self-hosted conditions (13 items), and no-Registry declaration. AGENTS.md covers 11 minimal repository-level rules. .codex/skills/flowkit-git-workflow/SKILL.md covers boundary templates, ordinary Commit principles, no-auto-commit, no-process-decision-authority. verification.md records applicable checks, no-Full-Test, and A1/B1/C1 consistency confirmations. D1 does not modify delivery-lifecycle.md or other B1 frozen docs. No Git Commit created per owner instruction.
